description: Election Commission - Declare that G. A.  W. S. K..Sammarathunga as a member of the Wrarakapola  Pradethiya Gabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government authority (Warakapola Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local government, including the resignation of a member, nomination of a replacement by the group leader, and the formal declaration of the new member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it concerns the composition of an elected local authority body through established electoral procedures.
